verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, so an official CLI is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about and the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes Dashboard-based workflows (documents tab, SAFEs from the Dashboard) and never mentions an Atlas CLI. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show AI-readable documentation, which is an adjacent capability and not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
